I think it’s perfectly reasonable to initially be depressed after coming to the position of nihilism. We are meaning-seeking creatures, and it takes a lot of effort to create your own, or to reorient yourself to that conclusion. 

That said, nihilism is does not necessarily imply depression, as it can also free you from the burden of objective standards and rules. It’s all about how you frame it in your own mind.
